entries.proposition: WWOX is measured only as a differentially expressed gene between ancestry groups inside the iOL cluster; the sentence that introduces it miscounts its own list, writing 'five' before naming six genes.
entries.snippet: only five AD GWAS hits were differentially expressed: ADAM17, CLU, EPDR1, FGF12, MAF, and WWOX
entries.anchor: Results, comparison with AD GWAS loci

entries.proposition: The WWOX numbers are two ancestry contrasts in iPSC-derived oligodendrocytes: fold change -1.34 with adjusted p 1.95E-05 (AF versus AI) and -1.33 with adjusted p 9.59E-03 (EU versus AI), both marked as not differing between males and females.
entries.snippet: AF versus AI iOL WWOX −1.34 AF 1.95E‐05 No MAF −2.20 AF 1.47E‐02 No EU versus AI iOL WWOX −1.33 EU 9.59E‐03 No

entries.proposition: The p values are cell-level MAST statistics with the cell detection rate as the only covariate; donor is not modelled, so nuclei from the same line are treated as independent observations.
entries.snippet: The differential expression of genes between ancestral groups within each cluster was determined using the MAST test

entries.proposition: The whole panel is 12 iPSC lines, four per ancestry, so each ancestry contrast rests on four donors.
entries.snippet: We generated a total of 12 iPSC lines (four AF, four AI, and four EU) in this study

entries.proposition: The denominator behind the p values is 47,898 nuclei across all 12 lines and all clusters, not per cluster.
entries.snippet: We characterized a total of 47,898 cells, with an average of 3991

entries.proposition: In the all-female re-analysis WWOX also reaches significance in the progenitor cluster, in one contrast of two AI females against four AF females.
entries.snippet: we identified two additional significant AD GWAS genes, ANK3 and WWOX, as differentially expressed between AI and AF
